text_sr: Stanite. Stanite, molim vas. Pre nego što nastavite, imam jednu veoma važnu vest.
text_en: Stop. Stop, please. Before you go on, I have some very important news.

text_sr: Ovo je jedino odmorište na planini na kojem se pouzdano zna da smo napredovali.
text_en: This is the only rest stop on the mountain where it is reliably known that we have made progress.

text_sr: To vi tako kažete. Ali ako se sve oko vas pomera nagore, ko je onda zaista u pravu?
text_en: So you say. But if everything around you is moving upward, who is really right?

text_sr: Ja sam odgovoran za ovo odmorište. Ne i za stanje na putu. To je vrlo važno da razumete.
text_en: I am responsible for this rest stop. Not for the state of the road. It is very important that you understand that.

text_sr: Pitali su me zašto su stepenice iza mene zazidane. A ja pitam vas: ko je rekao da morate negde da stignete?
text_en: They asked me why the stairs behind me are walled up. And I ask you: who said you have to get anywhere?

text_sr: Naravno. Odmor je strateška investicija. Samo nemojte da se opustite previše.
text_en: Of course. Rest is a strategic investment. Just don't relax too much.

text_sr: Imam. I to posao od istorijskog značaja. Ne mogu da vam kažem koliko je značajan dok ga ne obavite.
text_en: I do. And a job of historic importance. I can't tell you how important until you've done it.

text_sr: I treba da idete. Samo nemojte posle da kažete da vas nisam upozorio. Na šta tačno, to ćemo još utvrditi.
text_en: And so you should. Just don't say afterwards that I didn't warn you. Warn you about what, exactly, we have yet to determine.

text_sr: Imamo jedan ozbiljan problem. Rezultati postoje, ali nam nedostaju papiri koji to potvrđuju.
text_en: We have a serious problem. The results exist, but we're missing the papers that confirm them.

text_sr: To ćemo znati čim pronađete zapisnike. U međuvremenu, budite uvereni da je sve pod kontrolom.
text_en: We'll know as soon as you find the records. In the meantime, rest assured that everything is under control.

text_sr: Znao sam da mogu da računam na vas. Nisam znao ko ste do pre pola minuta, ali sam znao.
text_en: I knew I could count on you. I didn't know who you were until half a minute ago, but I knew.

text_sr: Poštujem vašu odluku. Samo nemojte posle da kažete da niste imali priliku da učestvujete u istoriji.
text_en: I respect your decision. Just don't say afterwards that you didn't get the chance to take part in history.

text_sr: Odlično. Dajte da vidim. Hm. Prvi zapisnik kaže jedno. Drugi kaže drugo. A treći ne kaže ništa.
text_en: Excellent. Let me see. Hm. The first record says one thing. The second says another. And the third says nothing.

text_sr: Dakle, svi preduslovi su ispunjeni za jedno veliko saopštenje.
text_en: So all the conditions are met for one big announcement.

text_sr: Saopštavamo da još nemamo konačno saopštenje.
text_en: We hereby announce that we do not yet have a final announcement.

text_sr: Znam ja rezultat. Samo rezultat još nije spreman da prizna samog sebe.
text_en: I know the result. The result just isn't ready to admit it to itself yet.

text_sr: Hvala vam. Vaša podrška mi je veoma važna, naročito kada još ne znamo šta se tačno dogodilo.
text_en: Thank you. Your support means a great deal to me, especially when we still don't know exactly what happened.

text_sr: Vidim da ste čovek od malo reči. To je pametno. Manje toga može da se proveri.
text_en: I see you're a person of few words. That's smart. Less of it can be checked.

text_sr: Sedite. Popijte nešto toplo. Ovde je opasno samo ako odlučite da nastavite.
text_en: Sit down. Have something warm. It's only dangerous here if you decide to carry on.

text_sr: Dobro došli u Privremene mere. Sve što vam prodajem ima trajnu cenu i privremeno dejstvo.
text_en: Welcome to Temporary Measures. Everything I sell you has a permanent price and a temporary effect.

text_sr: Ako niste kupili ništa, i to je doprinos lokalnoj privredi. Bar statistički.
text_en: If you didn't buy anything, that's a contribution to the local economy too. Statistically, at least.

text_sr: Srećan put. I nemojte da se osvrćete. Ova tribina mnogo lepše izgleda iz daljine.
text_en: Safe travels. And don't look back. This grandstand looks much nicer from a distance.

text_sr: Opet ste tu? To sam i očekivao. Ne mogu da kažem zašto, ali jesam.
text_en: Back again? I expected as much. I can't say why, but I did.

text_sr: Čujem da ste pali. Ja to ne bih tako nazvao. To je bilo kontrolisano upoznavanje terena.
text_en: I hear you fell. I wouldn't call it that. It was a controlled introduction to the terrain.

text_sr: Imamo problem s mostom. Tačnije, most ima problem s ponorom.
text_en: We have a problem with the bridge. More precisely, the bridge has a problem with the chasm.

text_sr: Izvođači radova. Ja sam samo lično prisustvovao svečanom otvaranju.
text_en: The contractors. I only attended the opening ceremony in person.

text_sr: Nemojte to zvati popravkom. Zovite to drugom fazom izgradnje.
text_en: Don't call it a repair. Call it the second phase of construction.

text_sr: Pronađite radnike ili donesite materijal. A kada most proradi, znaćemo da je naš plan bio ispravan.
text_en: Find workers or bring material. And when the bridge works, we'll know our plan was right.

text_sr: Eto. Rekao sam da će most biti gotov. Sad i oni koji nisu verovali mogu da pređu. Pažljivo.
text_en: There. I said the bridge would be finished. Now even those who didn't believe can cross. Carefully.

text_sr: Most i dalje ne funkcioniše? Dobro. Važno je da namera funkcioniše.
text_en: The bridge still doesn't work? Fine. What matters is that the intention works.

text_sr: Potrebna mi je jedna mala usluga. Simbolična, reklo bi se.
text_en: I need one small favour. A symbolic one, you might say.

text_sr: Dvanaest kilograma. Ali istorijska vrednost tog transparenta je nemerljiva.
text_en: Twelve kilos. But the historic value of that banner is immeasurable.

text_sr: Samo pazite da ne padne. Ako padne, reći ćemo da je tako bilo planirano.
text_en: Just make sure it doesn't fall. If it falls, we'll say it was planned that way.

text_sr: Fantastično! Pogledajte samo kako lepo stoji. Nije važno što se odavde uopšte ne vidi.
text_en: Fantastic! Just look how nicely it stands. Never mind that you can't see it from here at all.

text_sr: Pocepano? Nije to pocepano. To je modularna zastava. Savremeni pristup.
text_en: Torn? It isn't torn. It's a modular flag. A modern approach.

text_sr: Molim vas, samo malo tišine. Moram da objasnim zašto je sve u redu.
text_en: Please, just a little quiet. I have to explain why everything is fine.

text_sr: Nikada manje nismo pali za ovoliko vremena. Ako posmatrate iz pravog ugla.
text_en: We have never fallen less in so much time. If you look at it from the right angle.

text_sr: Kažu da je dno blizu. To govore već godinama.
text_en: They say the bottom is near. They've been saying it for years.

text_sr: Između nas, ni ja ne znam ko je postavio ovu govornicu.
text_en: Between us, I don't know who put up this podium either.

text_sr: Da je planina laka, svako bi se spuštao. Mada, koliko vidim, svi se spuštaju.
text_en: If the mountain were easy, everyone would go down it. Though, as far as I can see, everyone is going down.

text_sr: Ja ovde nisam zbog sebe. Meni bi bilo lepo i bez mikrofona. Samo, kome bih onda govorio?
text_en: I'm not here for myself. I'd be fine without a microphone. Only, who would I talk to then?

text_sr: Vetar duva nizbrdo. To je, očigledno, podrška našoj politici odmorišta.
text_en: The wind blows downhill. That is, obviously, support for our rest-stop policy.

text_sr: Ovde možete da odahnete. Odlazak je, nažalost, na sopstvenu odgovornost.
text_en: You can catch your breath here. Leaving is, unfortunately, at your own risk.

text_sr: Koliko stvari nosite? Pa vi ste opteretili čitavu privredu ovog odmorišta.
text_en: How much are you carrying? You've weighed down this rest stop's entire economy.

text_sr: Izgledate loše. Ali prema informacijama kojima raspolažem, stabilno ste.
text_en: You look bad. But according to the information at my disposal, you are stable.

text_sr: Novca nemate? Razumem. Važno je da imate poverenja. Mada bi nam i novac koristio.
text_en: No money? I understand. What matters is that you have trust. Although money would help us too.

text_sr: Nema veze. Uspeh je i to što ste se vratili, iako niste morali.
text_en: Never mind. It's a success that you came back at all, even though you didn't have to.

text_sr: Dame i gospodo, ovo će biti najbezbedniji silazak u istoriji! Molim vas, niko da se ne pomera dok ne završim.
text_en: Ladies and gentlemen, this will be the safest descent in history! Please, nobody move until I've finished.

text_sr: Razumem. Ima ljudi koji ne vole govore. Ja ih ne razumem, ali prihvatam.
text_en: I understand. Some people don't like speeches. I don't understand them, but I accept it.

text_sr: Znate šta mene stvarno brine? Ako se vi nikad ne zaustavite, kome ja onda govorim?
text_en: You know what really worries me? If you never stop, who am I talking to?

text_sr: Možda nema dna. A možda je dno samo mesto gde prestanemo da brojimo.
text_en: Maybe there is no bottom. And maybe the bottom is just the place where we stop counting.

text_sr: A gde da idem?
text_en: And where would I go?

text_sr: Znao sam jednog čoveka koji je otišao dole. Rekao je da će se vratiti kad pronađe kraj.
text_en: I knew a man who went down. He said he'd come back when he found the end.

text_sr: Nije.
text_en: He didn't.

text_sr: Zato ja ovde čekam. Neko mora da mu kaže da je stigao.
text_en: That's why I wait here. Someone has to tell him he's arrived.

text_sr: Ako ga sretnete, nemojte mu reći da sam čekao. Samo mu kažite da je mikrofon još uključen.
text_en: If you meet him, don't tell him I waited. Just tell him the microphone is still on.

text_sr: Ako pronađete kraj, nemojte odmah da mi javljate. Pustite me još malo da verujem.
text_en: If you find the end, don't tell me right away. Let me believe a little longer.
